_说明: 这一集自己的角色。参考图 refs/<id>.png 由 script.md 的 char_* 挑好后拷过去，图片不进仓库。小兔、小鹿只出现一次，不单独做角色，提示词里写全外形。

fox.desc: a small slim young fox with bright orange-red fur, a white chest and white tail tip, big pointy ears, big round shiny amber eyes with white highlights, a small black nose, a big fluffy tail, and a tiny red Chinese knot tassel tied around his neck
fox.keep: tiny red Chinese knot tassel at the neck, white tail tip, big ROUND amber eyes (never narrow)

tiger.desc: a big chubby friendly tiger with soft orange fur, dark brush-stroke stripes, a classic three-line stripe mark on his forehead, big round gentle amber eyes with white highlights, round soft cheeks and a calm friendly closed-mouth smile, big soft round paws
tiger.keep: three-line stripe mark on the forehead, big ROUND eyes, mouth closed with no teeth, no claws, plush-toy friendly

chick.desc: a tiny round fluffy yellow baby chick with a little orange beak, big round shiny black eyes and one little tuft of fluff on top of the head
chick.keep: one tuft of fluff on the head, smaller than a fist
